Selected audio is uploaded to voice.xwhisper.uk and sent to Groq for transcription. Text is saved locally as TXT. Temporary cloud sessions are deleted after completion, failure or cancellation; cleanup that fails due to connectivity or sign-in issues is retried during a later transcription with the same account. Original audio is kept. Only upload recordings you have permission to process.
